name: Le Lavoir Ltd (formerly Radhey Trade Holding Ltd)
tagline: Nano-cap turnaround play in laundry services with explosive revenue growth (173% YoY) but catastrophic profit margin collapse (41% to 5.6% in latest quarter) - management instability, negative FCF, and AGM governance failures signal HIGH CAUTION.
company_overview: Le Lavoir Ltd (BSE: 539814), incorporated in 1981 originally as a trading/holding company, rebranded in 2020 to pursue door-to-door laundry and dry-cleaning services. Headquarters in Rajkot, Gujarat; operating facility at Shah Industrial Estate, Saki Vihar Road, Andheri (E), Mumbai. Business model: outsourced laundry for institutional clients (hotels, offices) + B2C door-to-door pickup/delivery. Recently announced 5-year lease (2,400 sq ft) in Bengaluru (Oct 1, 2026). Capital-intensive expansion phase with significant CWIP (Rs 5.13 Cr). Signed MOU in Sept 2025 to acquire 51% of Tech Riser Pvt Ltd (status unclear post-MD-resignation).
investment_thesis: THESIS FIT: neither. The company presents a growth paradox: 151-173% revenue CAGR over 5 years masks severe underlying distress. While sales expand sharply (Rs 6.64 Cr in FY26 → Rs 8.95 Cr TTM), profitability has entered freefall post-peak: net margins compressed from 41% (FY25) → 25% (FY26) → 5.6% (Q1 FY27, latest). Working capital has imploded to -Rs 119 Cr; free cash flow is deeply negative (-Rs 120.79 Cr TTM). Management instability (MD resignation Aug 28, 2026; AGM rejection of 2 independent directors on Sept 29) combined with extreme stock volatility (-77% in 1yr, -79% from peak) and zero analyst coverage signals this is a distressed turnaround attempt, not a compounder. The cash burn profile, board dysfunction, and accrual-heavy earnings (89% accrual ratio) do not support a 10x-in-2-3-years thesis.

quality_metrics.fcf_assessment: CRITICAL RED FLAG: Deeply negative FCF despite reported profitability. Company is burning cash at unsustainable rate
quality_metrics.quality_score_rationale: Negative FCF and accrual dominance override ROCE/growth metrics

red_flag_reason: Convergence of distress: Q1 FY27 margin catastrophe (41% → 5.6%), deeply negative FCF (-Rs 120.79 Cr TTM), working capital days at 425, MD resignation, AGM board rejection, 89% accrual ratio, stock crashed 77% in 1yr, promoter holding only 3.51%, zero analyst coverage
deep_dive_summary: Le Lavoir is a nano-cap laundry services turnaround with classic distress signals: explosive revenue (173% YoY) masking margin implosion (41% → 5.6%), negative FCF, working capital chaos, and management instability. 89% of earnings are accruals, not cash. Stock's -77% crash reflects real value destruction. NOT a 10x-in-2-3-years candidate. Conviction: 18/100 (HIGH CAUTION). Recommendation: AVOID unless credible turnaround emerges. Next catalyst: Q2 FY27 earnings (Oct/Nov 2026)
